coverage.notes: Figures are ODFW estimates from mandatory harvest reporting, copied as printed per hunt and Wildlife Management Unit (unit id = ODFW WMU number, matched from the printed unit name to ODFW's WMU layer). A hunt that spans several units is listed under each unit with that unit's share. 'Statewide' rows are the Grand Total line of each ODFW report (one per weapon/report). Where ODFW printed a success rate above 100% (its harvest estimate exceeds its hunter estimate in tiny hunts) successPct is left blank. The 2024 PDFs ODFW links carry a large 'DRAFT' watermark. Unit-row sums match ODFW's zone and grand totals except for small rounding gaps and the agency-side differences named below. ODFW computes success from unrounded estimates, so in small hunts it can differ by a few points from harvest / hunters. Reports loaded per year: Any Legal Weapon (titled 'Rifle' for 2020), Archery, Muzzleloader and General Season Antlerless Elk Damage Tag (2020-2024). harvestMale = ODFW 'Total Bull(s)' column; antlerless harvest is in each row note; antler point classes are not loaded. General-season hunt labels are as printed and change wording between years (e.g. 'General Elk Rifle - Coast First Season' 2020, 'Coast 1st season' 2025). Not loaded: the 2025 damage-tag report (it repeats the 2024 report figure for figure; only the title year differs). Agency-side total differences: 2020 rifle Northeast general zone total (5,854 hunters) omits Heppner's 1,545; 2020 muzzleloader Grand Total 1,721 hunters / 321 elk vs 1,406 / 203 in its unit rows; 2024 damage Grand Total 5,776 / 2,993 vs 4,906 / 2,577 in its zone totals. Where ODFW lists the same unit and hunt twice with different figures (2021 archery 'Bow Elk w/ 250R' rows) both are kept and the second is labelled 'ODFW listing 2'.

ODFW reports deer without separating species: this file holds all Oregon deer hunts except the white-tailed-deer-only controlled hunts (see whitetail). Units 10-30 (western Oregon) are black-tailed deer range and carry a row note saying so; eastern units are mule deer range and can include some white-tailed deer. Reports loaded per year: Any Legal Weapon buck (titled 'Rifle' for 2020), Archery, Muzzleloader and Antlerless deer (titled '600 Series' in 2020). harvestMale = ODFW 'Total Buck(s)' column; antlerless harvest is in each row note; point classes are not loaded. The 2020 archery report prints unrounded fractional estimates (e.g. 110.5 hunters), kept as printed. 2020 antlerless Grand Total (6,991 hunters / 3,355 deer) differs from its zone totals (7,053 / 3,384).

White-tailed-deer-only controlled hunts in ODFW's deer harvest reports: hunts named 'Whitetail' (146R2 Grant Co Whitetail Bow, from 2024) plus hunts whose regulations bag limit is white-tailed deer only (151M Baker Muzzleloader, 152M Grande Ronde Muzzleloader, 157A Lower Wallowa Valley, 157M Sled Springs Unit Muzzleloader, 647B Middle Fork John Day, 649B W Blue Mtns, 651T2 Baker No. 2 Youth, 657A Flora, 657B Lower Wallowa Valley, 660A Upper Wallowa Valley). Bag limits come from the 2022-2024 regulations; 2020-2021 rows use the 2022 booklet and 2025 rows the 2024 booklet (those years' booklets were not retrieved; hunt codes carry over). Rows come from the Any Legal Weapon, Archery, Muzzleloader and Antlerless deer reports. All other white-tailed deer, taken in general eastern Oregon hunts or mixed-species controlled hunts, are inside ODFW's combined deer figures (mule-deer file). Figures are ODFW estimates from mandatory harvest reporting, copied as printed per hunt and Wildlife Management Unit (unit id = ODFW WMU number, matched from the printed unit name to ODFW's WMU layer). A hunt that spans several units is listed under each unit with that unit's share. 'Statewide' rows are the Grand Total line of each ODFW report (one per weapon/report). Where ODFW printed a success rate above 100% (its harvest estimate exceeds its hunter estimate in tiny hunts) successPct is left blank. The 2024 PDFs ODFW links carry a large 'DRAFT' watermark. Unit-row sums match ODFW's zone and grand totals except for small rounding gaps and the agency-side differences named below. ODFW computes success from unrounded estimates, so in small hunts it can differ by a few points from harvest / hunters. Spring controlled hunts and the general fall season ('Fall Bear', 'Additional Fall Bear' tags) by unit; harvestMale/Female as printed. In 2024-2025 ODFW lists some unit/hunt pairs twice with different figures (the second row has a blank unit label, e.g. 2025 Siuslaw 722A: 3 and 474 hunters); both rows are kept as printed, the second labelled 'ODFW listing 2', and they are not combined.

ODFW 'Reported Bighorn Sheep Harvest' tables (Rocky Mountain and California bighorn hunts): one row per hunt with tags (stored as licenses), animals harvested and percent success; hunter counts are not published (hunters null). unit = ODFW hunt number, unitName = hunt name. Auction, raffle and tribal tags are described only in the report footnote (not in hunt rows). Where ODFW printed more harvest than tags (e.g. 2025 546A, 568A1) success is left blank. 2025 lists hunt 559A1 twice ('N Snake Rvr' and 'S Snake Rvr'); the second is stored with unit '559A1 S Snake Rvr'.

ODFW 'Reported Rocky Mountain Goat Harvest' tables: one row per hunt with tags (licenses), harvest and percent success; hunter counts not published. unit = ODFW hunt number. Auction/raffle tags are described only in the footnote. Where harvest exceeds tags (2025 946A, 200%) success is left blank.

Figures are ODFW estimates from mandatory harvest reporting, copied as printed per hunt and Wildlife Management Unit (unit id = ODFW WMU number, matched from the printed unit name to ODFW's WMU layer). A hunt that spans several units is listed under each unit with that unit's share. 'Statewide' rows are the Grand Total line of each ODFW report (one per weapon/report). Where ODFW printed a success rate above 100% (its harvest estimate exceeds its hunter estimate in tiny hunts) successPct is left blank. The 2024 PDFs ODFW links carry a large 'DRAFT' watermark. Unit-row sums match ODFW's zone and grand totals except for small rounding gaps and the agency-side differences named below. ODFW computes success from unrounded estimates, so in small hunts it can differ by a few points from harvest / hunters. Cougar is a general-season species in Oregon: rows are per unit for 'Cougar' and 'Additional Cougar' tags (hunters = estimated tag holders who hunted). harvestMale/Female as printed. 2025 lists Siuslaw and Wilson twice for 'Cougar' with different figures; both kept as printed ('ODFW listing 2').

Spring season only: ODFW's 'Spring Turkey Harvest by Wildlife Management Unit' tables (hunters, hunter days, harvest, birds per hunter). Hunters and days are counted only in the unit each hunter reported hunting most. ODFW does not publish percent of hunters successful; successPct is harvest / hunters (successComputed) and a hunter may take more than one bird. 'Statewide' rows (2023-2025) are the Spring Turkey and Spring Youth Turkey lines of ODFW's Game Bird Program staff summaries. The unit tables sum to the spring + youth total in 2023 and 2024 but to the adult 'Spring Turkey' line in 2025. ODFW states an error in its mandatory reporting system likely inflated the 2025 harvest estimate. Fall turkey harvest is not published by unit. Rows with unit 'Unknown' are hunters who did not report a unit.
